# Problem 1
First, I am going to call the file path
```{r}
#| eval: FALSE
UnmixedFile <- file.path("C:/Users/Macarena/CytometryInR/course/03_InsideFCSFile/data/AdditionalFCSFiles/2025_07_26_AB_02_NY068_02_Ctrl.fcs")
UnmixedFile
```

Next, I need to activate flowCore

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE
library(flowCore)
```

Now, let's see the filename argument
```{r}
#| eval= FALSE
read.FCS(filename=UnmixedFile)
```

## Answer to the problem 1

The only different thing that I have observed is in the section that I called "Middle Metadata". In this section, you can see keywords with names like $`flowCore_$PXXRmax` or $`flowCore_$PXXRmin`, so this might be the difference between a raw spectral flow cytometry file and an unmixed .fcs file.
